articles.intent: Help readers choose a project by technique, materials and where they will display it.

articles.title: How to Decorate Your Christmas Mantel with Knitted Gnomes
articles.intent: Provide useful layout ideas for people planning a Christmas mantel decoration.
outline: Measure the available shelf depth and leave room for dangling legs.
Build three arrangements: simple Nordic greenery, cranberry-and-ivory accents, and a natural wood-and-linen palette.
Explain visual balance, clear shelf edges and using LED candles near yarn decorations.
Link to Hearthside in the shelf-sitter example and clearly label generated styling illustrations.
articles.originalValue: Usable styling diagrams or measured arrangements after a real sample is available; no invented finished measurements.

articles.title: A Beginner's Guide to Knitting Christmas Gnomes
articles.intent: Help newer knitters understand the skills to practise before choosing a gnome pattern.
outline: Distinguish knitting from crochet and explain the small components of a shelf sitter.
Practise joining in the round, kfb, k2tog, ssk, picking up stitches and a three-needle bind-off on small swatches.
Explain gauge checks, firm fabric, even stuffing and seam placement using original step-by-step examples.
Describe the Hearthside skill requirements honestly and link to its product page as an advanced-beginner-to-intermediate option.
articles.originalValue: Original knitting swatch demonstrations; label the linked crochet reading guide as a separate craft, not knitting instruction.
